sampling_revision_provenance.supersession_reason: the approved paper validation design requires four untouched seeds times eight mechanically fixed balanced histories, so sampling is expanded before any heldout output while the scientific method and thresholds remain unchanged

target_history_selection_rule: the four cyclic A/B/C/D orders and their reverses; the same eight targets are used for every seed; every stage appears exactly twice in every position across the eight targets

execution_sharing.unit: one heldout seed per independent workflow job
execution_sharing.equivalence_scope: sharing changes only duplicated model evaluations across the eight frozen targets for one seed; each target retains its own K3-frozen four-witness bank and its own six pairwise proof-safe LP decisions
execution_sharing.retained_k4_data: for each target, retain only four witness projections for each of 24 complete-history endpoints and their scalar Mobius interactions; no K4 model-space endpoint or interaction tensors are retained after streaming projection

certificate.wrong_relation_rule: for each unordered stage pair, the opposite orientation from the frozen target history is certified impossible only if the proof-safe multi-witness infinity-norm local-order lower bound exceeds 1e-6
certificate.true_relation_sanity: the class with the target orientation must have proof-safe Euclidean distance lower bound at most 1e-6
certificate.full_history_rule: a target is fully certified only when all six wrong orientations are excluded, all six true orientations pass sanity, and the surviving orientations uniquely reconstruct the frozen target history
certificate.abstention_rule: if one or more wrong orientations are not excluded but no invalidity occurs, the case is an abstention rather than an incorrect chronology output

required_validity_checks: source methodology/version and model settings match the frozen locks
all four heldout seeds and all eight target histories exactly match this lock
tokenizer fingerprint and FP64/FP32 base-parameter hashes reproduce the frozen environment
each seed builds one deterministic codebook and dataset from its frozen seed and records their hashes
the streaming exact K3 basis uses exactly 40 stage executions and caches all 24 exact degree-three prefixes
all eight target endpoints are replayed before any K4 lift and each target witness bank contains four unit witnesses
all 32 target-specific witnesses for a seed are frozen after exactly 72 stage executions and before the first K4 output
each target active lift reproduces its independently replayed endpoint hash when its complete-history word is streamed
every scalar K4 Mobius reconstruction matches the directly projected endpoint within 1e-8 absolute/relative numerical tolerance
each seed uses exactly 96 stage executions
every proof-safe pairwise lower bound is no larger than the corresponding direct exact Euclidean wrong-class distance beyond 1e-8
no true target precedence class is excluded
no full K4 model-space tensors are retained after streaming projection

outcome_classification.excellent: at least 28 of 32 full histories certified with zero invalid cases
outcome_classification.strong: 24 to 27 of 32 full histories certified with zero invalid cases
outcome_classification.partial: 16 to 23 of 32 full histories certified with zero invalid cases
outcome_classification.scientific_negative: 15 or fewer of 32 full histories certified with zero invalid cases
outcome_classification.invalid: any provenance/replay/freeze/reconstruction/certificate-soundness check fails or any true target precedence class is certified impossible

interpretation_rule: all four seed jobs belong to one frozen suite; no witness, threshold, target, codebook, interaction degree, solver correction, or success criterion may be modified after any heldout job begins; results are interpreted only under this lock
